FIELD NOTES

What you found

    Every pull tests fresh preparations. Notes reset with a new game.
    HOW TO PLAY

    Look. Try. Notice.

    Click objects or use the Journal, Table and Door buttons. W/A/S/D or arrow keys move between viewpoints. Escape steps back.

    Each lantern prints four marks. A lit mark counts as one. Count the lit marks to tell even from odd.

    No timer, no jump scares. Sound adds atmosphere; all clues are visible. This is an ideal quantum simulation inside a fictional room.
